## P0-I1
`tests/invariant-p0-i1.test.js` walks the real import graph from `server/index.js`: no module resolves to `famtastic-proof-job-routes`, nothing resolves outside the tree, and `FAMTASTIC_PROOF` appears nowhere except `server/kernel/invariants.js` where the prefix is named deliberately. `assertInvariants()` throws when a proof secret is present in the environment.

Each state names its own cause. No fabricated rows anywhere.

## Defect found and fixed during integration
The kernel router served `/kit/*` and `/app.css` but not `/pages/*.js`, so every page module 404'd, the shell never rendered, and all 11 pages lost their h1. The smoke gate caught it. Fixed in `server/kernel/app.js` and locked with `tests/kernel-app-static.test.js`. Worth noting: the failure mode looked exactly like an honest empty page, which is precisely the class of defect the honest-states rule is meant to make visible.
